text:
Priya Nair: Heads up — aiming to finish cloud store packaging for all three clouds today. Need final logo sizes, SKU table, EULA appendix, and the publish window.
Sam Liu: I can finalise the SKU table and pricing tiers. question: do we list both subscription and metered pricing or pick one per cloud?
Priya Nair: prefer subscription + optional metered add-on. legal asked for clarity in the listing copy.
Claire (Legal): Confirmed. one product page can include both models, but must surface clear billing terms and trial duration. i'll attach a short appendix for each marketplace with the required checkbox language (especially for Azure).
Diego Martinez: i'll take logos/screenshots. Design needs exact pixel dims. design-bot, can you paste the marketplace image specs?
design-bot: AWS banner: 1280x720 jpeg/png, thumbnail: 300x300, GCP tile: 1024x512, Azure hero: 1200x628. max file size 5MB. use transparent PNG for icons.
Sam Liu: SKU naming draft: RDW-INF-STD, RDW-INF-PRO, RDW-INF-ENTERPRISE, with cloud suffix when required (AWS/GCP/AZ). will create mapping sheet with entitlements and trial flags.
Priya Nair: Diego, for screenshots we need the console flow + quickstart. smaller annotations only. can you export both light and dark mode?
Diego Martinez: yep. will export: hero.png, thumb.png, first-run.mp4 (30s), quickstart-screenshot-1.png
Claire (Legal): small legal note: telemetry clause must be explicit per marketplace policy. include an opt-out contact and anonymization statement. also include support SLA summary on the listing (e.g., 24h first response for enterprise).
Priya Nair: good call. Sam — include support email and link to support SLA doc in the manifest.
Sam Liu: using partners-support@redwood.ai as primary. adding sla_link: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace/sla
marketplace-bot: Reminder: run `tools/marketplace/check_assets.py` and `tools/marketplace/validate_manifest.sh` before submitting. validation must pass in CI.
Priya Nair: CI publish window is Friday 10:00-13:00 PT (low-traffic). We should aim to submit by Thursday EOD.
Sam Liu: Pricing matrix ready. attaching link: https://redwood.internal/sheets/marketplace-pricing (internal).
Diego Martinez: uploaded images to staging bucket: s3://redwood-marketplace/staging/1768887776/ — tagged `marketplace-staging`.
Priya Nair: Claire, once you post the appendix i'll do a final review and create the publisher console draft for Azure and GCP.
Claire (Legal): Appendix uploaded: https://redwood.internal/legal/marketplace_appendix_draft_v3.docx. note: Azure requires a distributable terms checkbox and separate support contact fields.
Sam Liu: quick manifest snippet i'm planning to push (will be validated):
```
name: "Redwood Inference"
sku: "RDW-INF-PRO"
pricing:
  model: subscription
  price_monthly: "199"
  trial_days: "14"
support_email: "partners-support@redwood.ai"
images:
  hero: "s3://redwood-marketplace/staging/1768887776/hero.png"
```
Priya Nair: looks good. Diego — make sure image filenames match the manifest exactly.
Diego Martinez: done. filenames verified.
Priya Nair: last bits: Sam will upload manifests to each publisher console (IaaS accounts exist for staging). Diego will confirm images. Claire will finalize legal appendix. marketplace-bot will run validations. target: submit Thursday EOD for Friday publish window.
Sam Liu: action items acknowledged. will queue manifests and run validation in CI after Claire confirms appendix.
Claire (Legal): will review one more time and add the Azure checkbox text in the doc. expect final by 5pm PT.
Priya Nair: thanks team. ping me if any blockers. :rocket:
